title: Fix Web Audio API sound system (effects + background music)

requirements.text: Fix the Web Audio API sound system in `frontend/src/hooks/useTetrisAudio.ts` so that all sound effects (piece placement, line clear, level up, game over) and background music play correctly. Specifically: (1) defer AudioContext creation until the first user interaction (click/touch/keypress) to comply with browser autoplay policy; (2) resume a suspended AudioContext on each user interaction before playing any sound; (3) ensure the mute toggle correctly suspends/resumes both music and effects without destroying the AudioContext; (4) guarantee that background music loops without interruption once started; (5) fix any broken references so that the audio hook's play functions are correctly wired into the game loop in `useGameLogic.ts` and triggered on the appropriate game events.

quotes: Oyunda zil sesleri vardı arka plan sesi vardı bunların hiçbirisi çalışmıyor

acceptanceCriteria: Sound effects (piece placement, line clear, level up, game over) play audibly when the corresponding game events occur.
Background music starts looping after the first user interaction with the game and continues without interruption during gameplay.
No 'AudioContext was not allowed to start' browser console errors appear.
The mute toggle button silences all audio (effects and music) immediately and un-mutes them correctly on toggle.
AudioContext is not recreated on every mute/unmute cycle; the same context is reused throughout the session.
Sounds work correctly across all supported game modes (Classic, Time Attack, Endless, Challenge, Puzzle, Insanity, Mirror Mode, Gravity Shift, Combo Rush).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not remove or modify frontend/public/app-ads.txt.
Do not introduce PWA manifest or service worker changes.
nonGoals: Adding new sound effects or music tracks not already present.
Changing the visual theme or layout of any screen.
Modifying game logic or scoring rules.
